NWCC Saturday Zube Park Ride

Houston, TX · Hockley / Zube Park · Road

NWCC Saturday Zube Park Ride is a road group ride in Houston, TX. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from Zube Park.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 13 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the NWCC Saturday Zube Park Ride group ride

Northwest Cycling Club's main Saturday ride, northwest of Houston. Riders split into groups by ability. A led no-drop group does a 25-mile route along US 290 Business to Waller and back at about 13 mph, and teaches group riding skills along the way.
